playstyle.identity: Zac is a blob tank who bounces into teamfights and revives from his chunks. His engage range is massive and he provides tons of CC.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: on death, split into chunks that reform you. Q grabs two things and slams together. W does AoE damage. E charges a massive leap. R bounces, knocking up and moving enemies. E from fog for surprise engage, Q to slam enemies together, R in teamfights.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Zac spikes at level 4-5 with E range and level 6 for R CC. Tank items scale him. He's strong at engage and teamfighting.

passive.name: Cell Division
passive.summary: Abilities drop blobs that heal. On death, split into 4 chunks that reform.
passive.details: Zac's abilities drop chunks of himself that he can pick up to heal. When he dies, he splits into 4 bloblets. If any survive, he reforms.

abilities.name: Stretching Strikes
abilities.summary: Grab two targets and slam them together.
abilities.details: Zac's next auto grabs an enemy. Hitting a second target slams them together, dealing damage and briefly stunning.

abilities.name: Unstable Matter
abilities.summary: Burst, dealing AoE percent health damage.
abilities.details: Zac explodes, dealing percent max health damage to nearby enemies. Picking up blobs reduces the cooldown.

abilities.name: Elastic Slingshot
abilities.summary: Charge to slingshot and knock up enemies on landing.
abilities.details: Zac charges up, then launches himself to a location, knocking up enemies on landing. Longer charge = more range.

abilities.name: Let's Bounce!
abilities.summary: Bounce repeatedly, knocking up and moving enemies.
abilities.details: Zac bounces 4 times, each bounce knocking up enemies and moving them toward where he bounced.
